from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityData(BaseModel):
    """Enrollment data for a single university relevant to the diversity ratio calculation."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(..., description="The name of the university")
    report_date: str | None = Field(..., description="The reporting period or date (e.g., 'Fall 2021' or 'YYYY-MM') to resolve conflicts")
    total_undergraduates: int | None = Field(..., description="Total number of undergraduate students (denominator)")
    hispanic_latino_count: int | None = Field(..., description="Number of Hispanic/Latino undergraduate students")
    black_non_hispanic_count: int | None = Field(..., description="Number of Black or African American (non-Hispanic) undergraduate students")
    asian_non_hispanic_count: int | None = Field(..., description="Number of Asian (non-Hispanic) undergraduate students")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityData]
